_comment: Replace individual buildings with hand-made models. Key = building id from features.json (e.g. osm:way/137335923). The pipeline leaves overridden buildings out of the merged buildings.glb and the engines place the custom asset at the building's centroid_m / ground_min_m instead. See docs/MANIFEST.md. Example entry (disabled because its key starts with an underscore):

_osm:way/137335923.note: Grand Casemates barracks, hand-modelled from survey drawings
